title: scenario_command (client -> server)
description: Demo runner on /control (SITE_PROMPTS.md S10): trigger one simulated beat on cue, or reset the demo. Beats only drive the simulator (twin/<site>/<device>/cmd/*) and the movement engine; never the real board. Campus emergencies (F3): grid_failure (substation incomer loses the grid, generator starts), gas_leak (hazardous store), fire_alarm (warehouse fire panel bridge), compressor_fault (compressor trips, air pressure falls).
